title.description: Display title of the knowledge item

kind.description: doc = reference document, note = free-form note, glossary = term/definition, template = disposition/feedback template

term.description: For glossary items: the term being defined

content.description: Body text / definition / template content that the bots read as context

active.description: When true, bots include this item in their context

file_url.description: URL of an uploaded source file (image, doc, spreadsheet). Nullable.

source_type.description: How this knowledge item was created
